title: Knell
description:
You know where every corpse, and every creature in [[Agonie]], lies within 18 m of you, even out of sight or Caché, along with the Agonie value of each such creature. Knowing where a Caché creature lies does not let you target it. An Undead does not count as a corpse.

When you touch a corpse, you know how many hours ago the creature died, or how many days once it has been more than one.
